report: Checked every candidate group in the table and the dump end to end; found no construction analysed two ways without the source licensing the difference.

אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים (vv. 5, 6, 7, 12, 14) is uniform: the rectum's article takes the fronted 'the' and the construct 'ark' is bare, matching v. 1's שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים; the two bare-God articles (v. 8 'before God', v. 12 'afraid of God') are unrepresented because no 'the' is written, which is the same rule 29 count read on different English.

Waw treatments differ only by what the ASV wrote (And/and/So/but/even/that/'And when'); the two unrepresented waws (v. 2 before עִמָּהֶם recast as 'with whom', v. 9 apodosis after 'And when') are rule 17 and rule 14 respectively, not splits. The 'even' of v. 5 and v. 8 goes to the waw that is present; v. 1's 'even with' goes to the לְ because no waw stands there, and the note names the competing added reading.
Object markers: v. 12's 'afraid of' takes the 'of' under rule 16's first family; every other marker stands on an object rendered bare and is unrepresented. Consistent.

Phrasal particles: 'again' (v. 3 סָבַב hiphil), 'together' (v. 5), 'up' (v. 6), 'forth' (vv. 9, 10, 11), 'aside' (v. 13) each complete a lexeme the bare verb does not write; v. 12's 'home' is added with the competing clause-level reading named. That is a judgment on one verb, not a chapter split.
Compound names are uniform: Kiriath-jearim two tokens (vv. 5, 6); Obed-edom's first token takes the rectum's 'of' in both v. 13 and v. 14.

BSB disagreements are all documented convention differences (fronted articles, object markers, silenced dative/locative prepositions, לֵאמֹר, the cognate accusative פֶּרֶץ in v. 11 which the ASV writes nothing for). None is an error.

No convention recorded: the chapter's one recurring judgment (the ark-of-God article) is rule 29's own worked example, and the remaining repeated notes are routine. Nothing here generalises beyond the contract.
